description: HR-88 is the Regional Transport Office for the Badhra subdivision in the Charkhi Dadri district of Haryana. It operates as a Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) under the Sub-Divisional Officer (Civil), managing vehicle registrations and licensing for the local rural and urban population.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer (Civil), Badhra, District Charkhi Dadri, Haryana
